name: usage-list-status
goal: Show clean Used In and Uses lists while retaining the verification mark on each entity page.

evidence: Remove verification marks from Used In and Uses rows. Preserve names, role/change badges, descriptions and revision-aware links; keep the entity header mark.
Existing usage tests check sections and destinations, but not status placement. Strengthen their shared browser assertions and SSR coverage to reject row marks while retaining the header mark.
Red 685c4ee7 at 2149299b fails the no-row-marks assertion at desktop, tablet and mobile widths. The failing test commit precedes the product repair.
Both shared renderers omit per-row status components. Links, purpose text and kind/change/plan badges remain; entity header status stays available.
Green f410dd83 at 5da392e0 passes the unchanged usage browser cases at three widths and both renderer unit suites. Red 685c4ee7 uses the same 1,257 frozen inputs and environment.
